Indian players advance at Badminton Asia Junior Championships

Indian players Dhyan Santosh, Tanvi Patri, and Dev Ruparelia have advanced to the second round of the Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026. Santosh notably upset the sixth seed in his match. The tournament is currently underway.
